data.name: Bhadrak
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhadra' meaning 'auspicious', 'Bhadrak' is a name that signifies blessings and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, 'Bhadrak' is also the name of a demon, Bhadrakalpamsha, who is believed to bring prosperity and wealth. The name is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and tradition.
